literal: Greatly pleasant is the friendship of fools; at the time of separation, pain-giving one thing is not.
translation: The friendship of fools is highly pleasant, because when they part, there is not a single thing that causes pain.
modern: அறிவிலாதவர்களின் நட்பு மிகவும் இனிமையானது; ஏனெனில், அவர்கள் பிரியும்போது துன்பம் தருவது ஒன்றும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet uses irony to describe the friendship of foolish people. The poet states that their friendship is highly pleasant, but the reason is humorous: when the friendship ends and they part ways, it causes absolutely no sorrow or pain. Normally, parting from a true friend is painful, but parting from a fool brings only relief. Thus, the lack of pain during separation is what makes their friendship 'pleasant' in a satirical sense.
